593:t_009:6.en:
$$刹那$$
「Watch out, $$バナージ$$! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are coming!」

593:t_010:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Those pests had to show up now...!」

593:t_010:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「They don't distinguish between us and $$クロノ$$.」

593:t_010:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「A three-way battle at a time like this!?」

593:t_010:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! We can't afford to fight each other now!」

593:t_010:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're trying to run away like that!?」

593:t_010:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Why are you doing this!?」

593:t_010:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バンシィ$$'s system is closing his heart off even more...」

593:t_010:10.en:
$$フォウ$$
「If we don't stop it, he'll...!」

593:t_010:11.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「A psycho-machine that twists people...」

593:t_010:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「To a thing like that...!」

593:t_010:13.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Hurry, $$バナージ$$! The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are heading for Ensign $$リディ$$, too!」

593:t_010:15.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ can only see you! At this rate, they'll fuse with him!」

593:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm counting on you, $$バナージ$$!」

593:t_011:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, keep the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ away from $$バンシィ$$!」

593:t_011:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! You were fighting for $$オードリー$$, too!」

593:t_011:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So I'll stop you! As your comrade... As a man who fought with the same feelings!」

593:t_012:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Let's stop this, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

593:t_012:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「You held back so you wouldn't kill me!?」

593:t_012:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「You! How miserable do you have to make me before you're satisfied!?」

593:t_012:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「A kid like you gets praised as a $$ニュータイプ$$ and goes around making a mess of everything!」

593:t_012:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ニュータイプ$$s...! A human subspecies that embodies $$ラプラスの箱$$'s curse...! Someone has to sacrifice themselves to quell it!」

593:t_012:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「The $$マーセナス家$$ left the curse behind, and the $$ビスト家$$ kept it hidden...!」

593:t_012:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「Only we, the heirs of those two families, can settle this tie!」

593:t_012:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「It wasn't supposed to be like this...! It was a prayer, not a curse! If only $$ニュータイプ$$s had never been born!」

593:t_012:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Calm down, $$リディ$$! The machine is swallowing you up!」

593:t_012:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「So what!? I'm trying to defeat a new humanity that seeks to evolve! Selling my soul to a machine is nothing...!」

593:t_012:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$! Open your heart!」

593:t_012:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't you understand, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

593:t_012:15.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You're a $$ニュータイプ$$, too! The light of $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$ is coming from inside you!」

593:t_013:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to those who emit $$脳量子波$$. Your strong feelings may be what called them here.」

593:t_013:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「And you have the power to master that $$バンシィ$$.」

593:t_013:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You should be able to hear them! Everyone's worried about you! $$オードリー$$, Ensign $$ミヒロ$$, and everyone!」

593:t_013:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Then I won't use words... But... Even so...!)

593:t_013:8.en:
$n
(You always helped me with my special training, Ensign. Let me repay you!)

593:t_013:9.en:
$$キラ$$
(You were willing to give your life fighting for Princess $$ミネバ$$. You're just like us...!)

593:t_013:10.en:
$$エマ$$
(Where did the man who wanted to prove himself without relying on the $$マーセナス家$$ go!?)

593:t_013:11.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
(A pilot lives by skill alone! Family, bloodlines - they can all eat shit!)

593:t_013:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(You always used to look forward!)

593:t_013:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Don't let that talent rot!)

593:t_013:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
(You're too good a man for it to end here!)

593:t_014:0.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Your heart must know what you have to do now...)

593:t_014:2.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(Lend your strength to $$バナージ$$... To us... And to humanity's future.)

593:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「This is an illusion...! The $$サイコミュ$$ is picking up people's stray thoughts!」

593:t_014:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(The machine is only amplifying them. That $$バンシィ$$ is a beast of possibility, too...)

593:t_014:5.en:
$$ミネバ$$
(It has a system that responds to people's hearts...)

593:t_014:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「People's hearts... Our hearts can reach each other...?」

593:t_014:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You saw it at $$アクシズ$$, too! People's hearts gathering in a machine!」

593:t_014:10.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
(Be your true self again, Ensign $$リディ$$! Don't hurt yourself any more!)

593:t_014:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「All of you...! Are all of you rejecting me!?」

593:t_016:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$, what are you doing!?」

593:t_017:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「If you get in my way, I'll take you with it!!」

593:t_017:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$...! You...! I told you not to leave me alone!」
